items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We went and spoke to Jimmie Lunceford, who was a great, big time bandleader

ctx.x: When you were with this band, did you go on tour? Were you able to leave the Phoenix area?

Well, yes. We would stay in the state of Arizona and go around to other towns and play a dance here and there, like the Elks or something like that, but we didn’t leave the state of Arizona. We were like 14, 15, 16 [years old]. There were a couple of guys who were older than us, but they had day jobs, and they couldn’t be going around. We went and spoke to Jimmie Lunceford, who was a great, big time bandleader, and we told him that we had our band and we wanted to go on the road. He said, “You do? Alright,…
